services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: Get ready for a summer of fun at Broadway Bound! Campers don’t just put on a show, they build confidence, learn to work as a team, and become responsible rockstars. No experience? No problem! These camps are designed to build self-esteem as students refine their creativity, active listening, and concentration skills all while learning about musical theatre. In this camp, preschoolers will participate in basic theatre techniques and work on creating a production out of some well loved children’s stories.
